<function name="AddAllPlayers" parent="CRecipientFilter" type="classfunc">
	<description>Adds all players to the recipient filter.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Adds all players to a recipient filter, then uses the recipient filter in a usermessage.</description>
	<code>
function SendMessage()
	local filter = RecipientFilter()
	filter:AddAllPlayers()
	umsg.Start("message",filter)
	umsg.End()
end
	</code>
	<output>Sends a usermessage to every player.</output>
</example>
